name: The Watchtower of Forbidden City
description: There are four turrets in the Forbidden City, located at the four corners of the Forbidden City. Together with the city walls and moats, they are part of the palace's defense facilities. Each turret has nine beams, eighteen columns, and seventy-two ridges. The overall structure is compact and decorated with red gold, highlighting the grace and splendor of the turret. The panoramic version includes part of the city wall, presenting a turret with a more comprehensive environmental landscape.
